convert_regnet_to_mmdet: convert pycls pretrained RegNet model keys to mmdet style and save checkpoint
run_regnet2mmdet_cli: run the regnet2mmdet CLI tool to convert a detectron RegNet model to mmdet format
convert_stem_layers: convert stem convolution and batch norm layers from pycls naming to mmdet naming convention
convert_head_layers: convert head fully connected layers from pycls naming to mmdet naming convention
convert_resnet_layers: convert residual layer blocks from pycls naming to mmdet naming convention
